args.goal: Qualify one Canadian partner placement for the existing free, bounded catalogue diagnostic. First read the accountless-route and existing-audience-referral results, the completed catalogue buyer-alternatives decision, and the aligned outreach handoff. Reuse any equivalent result and exclude previously approached or queued prospects. Through public sources, examine at most three Canadian ecommerce practitioner organizations with a published invitation to submit supplier education resources. Select at most one whose audience matches catalogue migration or QA and whose published rules or operator evidence support this resource, its AI disclosure and an authorized submission route. Silence about AI or submission eligibility leaves that prerequisite unresolved. For a qualifying route, prepare only the exact requested placement text linking to the verified live diagnostic, and record what evidence would establish placement, a qualified referral and eventual revenue separately. Keep the diagnostic free and leave paid packaging parked unless a concrete eligible request or material gap in alternatives emerges. If no route qualifies, save a brief decision with source links, dates, quotations and the specific fact that would change it. Save and read evidence under products/distribution/canadian-catalogue-partner/. No external messages, submissions, accounts, site changes or spending. Close with a valid lease and a lesson.
